summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by Vodafone Group disclosing a TR-1 major holdings notification, indicating that Credit Agricole S.A. crossed the 5% threshold, now holding 5.66% of voting rights. No acquisition or disposal by the company, no tender offer, no management change, no restructuring. It is a standard regulatory disclosure of a shareholder threshold crossing under UK DTR rules, not a special situation event.
